The quickest retention fix for short-form videos takes 5 seconds in your editor:

Cut the first 2 seconds where you clear your throat or say 'Hey guys, today I want to show you...'.

Start directly on the mistake, the visual contrast, or the outcome. If viewers understand what is happening in frame one with the sound muted, your 3-second hold rate jumps.

Forward this to a creator friend who still opens with a 3-second greeting.

Why 10 saves and 5 DM shares push an Instagram Reel further than 100 passive likes:

1. Likes take 0.2 seconds while scrolling fast.
2. Saves tell the ranking system people intend to revisit your post.
3. DM shares ('Sends per reach') introduce your page directly to warm non-followers.
